scope: Focused follow-up of WorkSafeBC and unresolved program/timeline logos. Source dates identify specimens, not adoption or first use.

organizations.summary: Recovered three native vector specimens: a distressed WorkSafe wordmark in the 2003 annual report, the black/orange mark with tagline in the 2004 report, and a contemporary black/orange specimen in the 2024 report. Neither the sought 1968 WCB logo nor the 1983 worker-emblem original is resolved by these finds.

sources.assessment: The serif WorkSafe wordmark with the board’s name is present in the 2003 annual report. White lettering beneath its dark block requires a dark ground. This is an additional dated specimen, not a replacement for the separately documented 1983 worker-protection emblem.
sources.date_meaning: 2003 is the reporting year in the title. The PDF was created in April 2004. Neither establishes adoption or first use.

sources.assessment: Original black-and-orange WorkSafeBC artwork from the 2004 annual report. All lettering and blocks are native outlines. The “Working to make a difference” tagline is retained; the separate website-address line is excluded.
sources.date_meaning: 2004 is the reporting year in the title. The PDF was created in September 2005. Neither establishes adoption or first use.

sources.assessment: Original black-and-orange WorkSafeBC artwork from the 2024 annual report. All lettering and blocks are native outlines. The surrounding orange page background and cover photograph are excluded.
sources.date_meaning: 2024 is the reporting year in the title. The PDF was created in May 2025. Neither establishes adoption or first use.
